units.rawText: Eucharist gives the table a light knock with a piece in her hand, and soon, the cracked surface of the board is restored to pristine condition.
units.displayText: Eucharist gives the table a light knock with a piece in her hand, and soon, the cracked surface of the board is restored to pristine condition.

units.rawText: Might I ask if you are appeased by these diverting theatrics, Professor?
units.displayText: Might I ask if you are appeased by these diverting theatrics, Professor?

spans.text: Might I ask if you are appeased by these diverting theatrics, Professor?

units.rawText: I had thought you were frustrated beyond help with the position you had fallen into.
units.displayText: I had thought you were frustrated beyond help with the position you had fallen into.

spans.text: I had thought you were frustrated beyond help with the position you had fallen into.

units.rawText: How droll, Professor. See, though, isn't it back to how it was before already?
units.displayText: How droll, Professor. See, though, isn't it back to how it was before already?

spans.text: How droll, Professor. See, though, isn't it back to how it was before already?

units.rawText: Fractures on the board are easy enough to patch up, but I'm afraid I can't say the same for some other places.
units.displayText: Fractures on the board are easy enough to patch up, but I'm afraid I can't say the same for some other places.

spans.text: Fractures on the board are easy enough to patch up, but I'm afraid I can't say the same for some other places.

units.rawText: Eucharist's fingers lightly caress the black queen.
units.displayText: Eucharist's fingers lightly caress the black queen.

spans.text: Eucharist's fingers lightly caress the black queen.

units.rawText: A beautiful piece, is it not?
units.displayText: A beautiful piece, is it not?

spans.text: A beautiful piece, is it not?

units.rawText: What other sentient Entropics like Demiurge do you have in the field? Or is that an Entropy-infected agent?
units.displayText: What other sentient Entropics like Demiurge do you have in the field? Or is that an Entropy-infected agent?

spans.text: What other sentient Entropics like Demiurge do you have in the field? Or is that an Entropy-infected agent?

units.rawText: How many accomplices do you have other than her?
units.displayText: How many accomplices do you have other than her?

spans.text: How many accomplices do you have other than her?

units.rawText: Look, Professor. You're already here. If I were you, I'd just sit back and enjoy the game.
units.displayText: Look, Professor. You're already here. If I were you, I'd just sit back and enjoy the game.

spans.text: Look, Professor. You're already here. If I were you, I'd just sit back and enjoy the game.

units.rawText: These questions are self-answering, no? Rather, you should pay attention.
units.displayText: These questions are self-answering, no? Rather, you should pay attention.

spans.text: These questions are self-answering, no? Rather, you should pay attention.

units.rawText: The white side's clock begins its metronomic progression as I drag my attention back to the board.
